$comment: Machine-readable record of the Classical design system. This file and the
:root block at the top of styles.css describe the SAME parameters and must
be changed together: if they disagree, the system has started to rot.
Ramps were generated in OKLCH on one shared perceptual lightness scale, so
the same step of any ramp carries the same visual weight.
name: Classical
direction: Editorial and book-like on a soft near-white ground. Justified body copy at a comfortable measure, headlines flush-left over the block, hairline rules carrying the structure. Colour is applied as stroke, not fill. Surfaces stay quiet: cards bordered, buttons outlined. Photographs matted like tipped-in plates.

rules.strokeNotFill: Colour appears as borders, rules and underlines. No component takes a solid accent fill, including .btn-primary.
rules.noBold: Interface headings cap at fontWeights.heading (600). Display sizes take fontWeights.display (400): the bigger the text, the lighter it sets.
rules.noRawUnits: Use the space and radius scales. Raw px appears only inside :root.
rules.elevation: Only shadows.sm / md / lg. Elevation is a whisper.
rules.figures: Tabular figures wherever numbers stand as figures or columns (kickers, contents numerals, tables, charts, display numerals). Running prose keeps text figures: Lora's tabular feature widens word spaces and punctuation, which would loosen justified copy.
rules.icons: Lucide (https://lucide.dev), inlined as stroke SVG. No emoji, ever.
rules.contrast: The accent-to-ground pair is tuned to at least 3:1, which covers icons, large text and interface chrome and NOT body copy. Paragraph-size text in the accent uses colors.accentText (--color-accent-700).

ramps.$comment: Steps 100-300 are tinted fills, hovers and subtle borders; 500 is the role base; 700-900 are text on tinted fills and pressed states. Prefer a ramp step over an ad-hoc color-mix().

lightnessScale.$comment: Shared across every role. Step 500 is pinned to the accent's own OKLCH lightness.

chromaEnvelope.$comment: Chroma cannot hold flat across a ramp: near white and near black the sRGB gamut has none to give. Multipliers on the role's base chroma.

generation.gamutMapping: Chroma is reduced by bisection until the colour is inside sRGB. Lightness and hue are preserved exactly; clipping RGB channels instead would shift both and break the shared scale.

neutral.role: The ground's own hue at a whisper of chroma (0.006), so a neutral tint never reads cold against the near-white paper.

accent-2.role: MACHINE-DERIVED STAND-IN. The scheme is mono: it has exactly one accent. This set exists only so that any rule referring to accent-2 still resolves. It is the accent's hue nudged +6 degrees at 0.86 chroma, which keeps it a sibling rather than a second brand colour. Treat accent and accent-2 as ONE role.

contrastAudit.$comment: WCAG 2.1 relative-luminance ratios against the ground #f3f2f2, measured from the hex values above.

accent-on-bg.note: Chrome, icons and large text only. Not body copy.

heading.stack: "Cormorant Garamond", "EB Garamond", Garamond, "Palatino Linotype", Palatino, Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif

body.stack: "Lora", Georgia, Cambria, "Times New Roman", Times, serif

mono.stack: "SFMono-Regular", "SF Mono", ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace

families.loading: @import at the top of styles.css, so the one stylesheet is self-contained. The fallback stacks are real: offline the page still sets in a Garamond-adjacent and a serif text face.

weights.$comment: Bold is avoided. 600 is the ceiling for interface headings and display sizes deliberately take the normal cut.

space.$comment: 4px base at a density of 1.15, so one step is 4.6px. Airy by design. Use the scale, never a raw px.

motion.reducedMotion: All animation and transition durations collapse under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

interactionStates.$comment: Built once at the system level in section 6 of styles.css. Never restyled per page.
interactionStates.hover: Every interactive element takes a tint from a light ramp step.
interactionStates.pressed: One step past the base on the accent ramp: --color-accent-600 on this light ground, --color-accent-400 on dark, and a color-mix() tint for outlined and ghost variants that have no fill to darken.
interactionStates.focusVisible: :focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset: 2px; } - never the default blue ring.
interactionStates.disabled: 45% opacity, not-allowed cursor, and no pointer response.

btn.note: Primary is an accent OUTLINE, never a fill.

tag.note: Light ramp step as the fill, matching dark step as the text.

plate.note: A warm archival grade inside a thin surface-coloured mat. Every content photograph goes through it.

notBuilt.$comment: Deliberately out of scope for this package; the token sheet, component layer and the rebuilt DApp are the deliverable.
